Today's 9to5Toys midday sale mainly features the AirPods Pro 3 with a continued $50 discount, but today's headline on Amazon sees the AirPods 4 (Active Noise Cancellation version) also drop to its lowest price in months, going for as low as $119. Amazon also offers $150 off the base M5 MacBook Pro (compared to the new pricing), up to $400 off the M5 Pro/Max models, and $150 off the Apple 24GB M5 MacBook Air. On top of these deals, the entire Apple Watch Series 11 lineup is over $100 off, plus Hyper's latest 120Gbps Thunderbolt 5 dock with SSD enclosure hits a rare new low on Amazon at $80 off. See below for details.

AirPods 4 (Active Noise Cancellation version) at its lowest price in months today on Amazon, AirPods Pro 3 $50 off, other models from $99

Apple's latest AirPods Pro 3 are $50 off this week, a decent opportunity for those who missed last month's Prime Day deals. Meanwhile, the entry-level AirPods 4 series also have ongoing discounts nearing 25% off the original price; starting this morning, the AirPods 4 (Active Noise Cancellation version) have dropped to their lowest price in months, at just $144.99 with shipping.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $200 (originally $249)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (originally $129)
  • AirPods 4 (Active Noise Cancellation version) $145 (originally $179)

As shown above, Amazon's deals on the base AirPods 4 and AirPods Pro 3 are still going, but if you want to get Apple's current most affordable active noise cancellation earbuds, the AirPods 4 (Active Noise Cancellation version) have dropped to their lowest price since March.

Amazon is currently selling the AirPods 4 (Active Noise Cancellation version) for $144.99 (with shipping). Originally $179, this is a direct 20% discount and the lowest price we've found.

This price is also the lowest we've reported on Amazon since early-to-mid March — the AirPods (Active Noise Cancellation version) didn't drop below $149 during this year's Prime Day, and were selling for as much as $164 at the beginning of last month.

Amazon selling base M5 MacBook Pro ($150 off compared to new pricing), M5 Pro/Max up to $400 off

M5, M5 Pro, and M5 Max lineups have seen price increases, but if you're looking to pick one up now, Amazon at least has some discounts. The base M5 model is up to $150 off compared to the new pricing, while some higher-end 16-inch models are up to $400 off.

  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 16GB/1TB $1,849 (originally $1,999)
  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $2,049 (originally $2,199)
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 48GB/1TB $3,299 (originally $3,599)
  • 16-inch M5 Max MacBook Pro 48GB/1TB $3,999 (originally $4,399)

The above are the configurations with the deepest current discounts. The M5 is $150 off compared to the new pricing, the M5 Pro is up to $300 off, and the M5 Max is up to $400 off.

Yes, pricing has gone up — less than a month ago these machines were cheaper than they are now, but facts are facts: if you want to buy, you certainly don't want to pay more buying directly from Apple. Whether this price will drop further, we don't know for now.

The more affordable M5 MacBook Air is the same — Amazon also has several configurations $150 off compared to the new pricing:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,449 (originally $1,599)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,649 (originally $1,799)

Apple 24GB M5 MacBook Air currently $150 off on Amazon compared to new pricing

Apple has raised prices, and when this memory crunch will end is unknown. With that in mind, we want to highlight the current deals on the 24GB M5 MacBook Air while you can still grab one, in case things continue to deteriorate — Amazon has several configurations $150 off compared to the new pricing.

Amazon is currently selling the 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 24GB memory and 1TB storage for $1,649 (with shipping).

Apple and other retailers currently sell this machine for $1,799, but right now you can get all three colors for $150 less.

Although it feels a bit bitter compared to the recent RAM crunch price hikes, there's no turning back now, and it looks like the new official pricing won't drop in the short term — or ever. It looks like they may very well raise prices again, but it's hard to say for certain. We may still see deals like today's throughout the year, but it's hard to be sure right now.

Same goes for the MacBook Pro models:

Upgrade your Apple Watch for summer while the Series 11 is still $299 (all colors)

Summer is in full swing, and Apple Watch Series 11 deals keep coming, with the entry-level model getting a direct $100 discount. Whether you're preparing a summer birthday gift, getting ready for back-to-school, or just wanting to upgrade your own wearable, you can save some money.

We may see deeper discounts in the fall, but if for various reasons you want to pick up the latest Apple watch now, there's quite a bit to save right now.

42mm model — the most affordable Series 11 option — is now on sale for $299 (with shipping). We reported on this deal when it first appeared last weekend, and Amazon now has it available in all four case colors: Jet Black, Rose Gold, Silver, and Space Gray.

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (originally $399)
  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell from $399 (originally $499)

This is the latest generation Apple Watch originally priced at $399, now with a direct $100 discount.

If you want the larger 46mm case, most (but not all) colors are $100 off compared to pricing. Also keep an eye on the 46mm Cellular model below — currently $130 off:

  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (originally $429)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell from $399 (originally $529)

Hyper's latest 120Gbps Thunderbolt 5 dock with SSD enclosure hits new low on Amazon, $80 off

If you're using a newer Mac and want a proper Thunderbolt 5 dock to upgrade your connectivity options and support multiple displays, going cheap can be a real headache. I've run into plenty of monitor setup issues myself, so this rare deal on the Hyper HyperDrive Next Thunderbolt 5 dock with SSD enclosure is really nice.

Amazon is currently selling the 2026 HyperDrive Next Thunderbolt 5 dock with SSD enclosure for $319 (with shipping).

Compared to the original $400 price, that's a direct $80 off, the lowest price we've tracked on Amazon. This deal was originally a Prime Day limited-time offer for Prime members, then returned to full price, and is now back.

Still not cheap, but for a 120Gbps Thunderbolt 5 dock, this is the latest and most powerful model from a brand that truly supports Mac, featuring "support for three high-resolution display outputs on Windows PCs and MacBook Pro M5 Pro/Max laptops."

It supports up to three 4K 60Hz displays or one 8K 144Hz display, providing "smooth motion and sharp detail. Other macOS and Chrome OS devices support up to two extended displays."

It also has built-in M.2 PCIe Gen 4 x4 and Gen 3 slots, allowing for storage expansion in an extremely elegant and clean way while greatly increasing connectivity options:

  • 2 Thunderbolt 5 downstream ports
  • 3 USB-A (10Gbps)
  • RJ-45 2.5Gbps Ethernet
  • 3.5mm audio
  • Nano and standard anti-theft lock slots
  • 140W power pass-through
  • DC 20V power supply

Limited time deal: Nomad slashes another 25W Qi2 Stand One MagSafe charger to as low as 30% off, Cosmic Orange hits new low

Nomad's 2026 anniversary celebration is in full swing, but today they've slashed their latest 2-in-1 25W Qi2 Stand One MagSafe charger again. The premium metal and glass charger in black and white is now 30% off, and the brand new Cosmic Orange hits an all-time low.

  • Nomad 2-in-1 25W Qi2 Stand One MagSafe Charger $90 (originally $129) in black or white
  • Nomad 2-in-1 25W Qi2 Stand One MagSafe Charger $111 (originally $139) in brand new Cosmic Orange

We're still tracking the 3-in-1 25W Stand One Max launch deal at 20% off, but it looks like Nomad's 2-in-1 model today took the form of their past daily deal format — yesterday's discount was 20% off.

Besides the further price drop on black and white, the brand new Cosmic Orange colorway's pricing has also been reduced for the first time, 20% off, hitting a new low.

Anker 2026 summer deals from $8: smart display chargers, 25W 3-in-1 MagSafe stands, hubs, car mounts, and more

Today's accessory and charging deals:

  • SSD prices are rough right now, but this 1TB pocket hard drive is 40% off today at just $180
  • Satechi anodized aluminum Slim EX wireless mouse with metal scroll wheel for just $24
  • ASUS brand new 27-inch ProArt 4K 240Hz QD-OLED professional-grade monitor hits new low at $300 off
  • UGREEN NeoDrive Go 1TB USB4 SSD with built-in 40Gb/s cable hits new low at just $300 (originally $500)
  • Anker 10-outlet flat plug power strip on Amazon for just $20
  • UGREEN 14th anniversary celebration kicks off, deals from $7: buy one get one half off, brand new low prices, and more
  • This 2-pack of spring cable USB-C cables from $7.50 each (multiple colors)
  • Friendly reminder! Lexar's 2TB iPhone pocket SSD originally $480 is $220 off today

Amazon Renewed Premium iPhone 17 Pro models $220 off today, others up to $449 off

We've tracked plenty of decent deals on Amazon's renewed iPhone 17 Pro, but the discounts on their top-tier Renewed Premium versions haven't been all that attractive. Now we're tracking the latest iPhone 17 Pro in three colors all up to $220 off compared to new pricing.

All products below are sold and shipped directly by Amazon (not third-party sellers), and are all Renewed Premium grade — Amazon's highest quality renewed products, backed by a 1-year Amazon Renewed Guarantee, with battery life "exceeding 90% of original."

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (originally new $1,499)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,279 (originally new $1,499)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (originally new $1,499)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,199 (originally new $1,299)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,199 (originally new $1,299)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,199 (originally new $1,299)

The real highlight here is the 1TB model, now $220 less than Apple's new device pricing. The 512GB model is $100 off, but for some people it may not be enticing enough to give up on buying new.

That said, these are some of the best deals we've tracked on Amazon Renewed Premium versions, but you can still find cheaper "excellent" grade renewed units on Amazon — the main difference being only a 90-day Amazon Renewed Guarantee, and battery capacity "exceeding 80% of original":

  • iPhone 17 Pro 512GB Deep Blue $1,107 (originally new $1,299)
  • iPhone 17 Pro 512GB Cosmic Orange $1,139 (originally new $1,299)
  • iPhone 17 Pro 512GB Silver $1,120 (originally new $1,299)
  • iPhone 17 Pro 1TB Cosmic Orange $1,240 (originally new $1,499)
  • iPhone 17 Pro 1TB Deep Blue $1,263 (originally new $1,499)

These 17 Pro Max models from Woot are up to $49 off — "brand new unopened" with "testing sticker showing 100% battery life," plus "stylish custom black packaging."

  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 512GB $1,300 (originally $1,399)
  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 1TB $1,450 (originally $1,599)
  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 2TB $1,550 (originally $1,999)
